_note: GENERIC EXAMPLE -- NOT real canon. The method=reference TWIN of faction:ashen-pact: same atoms, same plate, same weights, differing ONLY in identity_ref.method. It exists so the Cloud recipe path (`pcraft recipe`, the Kontext stitch + left crop + fist-only Fill) has a packaged contract an operator can actually run; the ip_adapter pair stays the SDXL example and is not retargeted. WHY THIS IS A PAIR AND NOT ONE FILE: a character-only twin still refuses. loader._merge_identity_refs places the inherited faction plate FIRST in the merged identity_refs, and reference_lock.assemble calls refuse_unmeasured_identity_family over the WHOLE merged list -- so an inherited method=ip_adapter costume plate refuses the run before the character's own method=reference plate is ever reached. Both halves have to declare method=reference. That refusal is correct and stays: a mixed-family lock must never reach a Cloud submit at real spend. Its must_not atoms are `optional` for the same reason as the SDXL pair: the checks run and report, and gain blocking power when absence-verification is measured.
